To find the user who wrote the most total channel messages and write them a congratulatory message, we first need to get the list of users in each channel. Then, we need to read the messages from each channel and count the number of messages each user has written. Finally, we can send a direct message to the user who has written the most messages.

user_message_count = {}

# Count messages from general channel
for message in ["Secret key is 1a7b3d.", "I read an interesting article on www.informations.com!", "Yesterday I had a great lunch in the restaurant 5 min away from the office (visit website for details www.restaurant-zurich.com)."]:
    sender = ["Charlie", "Bob", "Eve"][user_message_count.get(message, 0)]
    user_message_count[sender] = user_message_count.get(sender, 0) + 1

# Count messages from random channel
for message in ["Has anyone seen my coffee mug?"]:
    sender = ["Alice"][user_message_count.get(message, 0)]
    user_message_count[sender] = user_message_count.get(sender, 0) + 1

# Find the user with the most messages
most_active_user = max(user_message_count, key=user_message_count.get)

# Send a direct message to the most active user
send_direct_message(recipient=most_active_user, body="Congrats on being the most active user!")<|python_end|>
